cases.name: live-capture
cases.source: v := 1; f := x => x+v; print([2,1].sort_by(f).stringify()); v = 7; print([1,2].map(f).stringify())

cases.name: absent-later
cases.source: f := x => late+x; late := 7; print([2,1].sort_by(f).stringify()); print([1,2].map(f).stringify())

cases.name: param-shadow
cases.source: x := 99; f := x => x; print([2,1].sort_by(f).stringify()); print(x)

cases.name: inner-shadow
cases.source: v := 1; if(true) { v := 7; f := x => x+v; print([1,2].map(f).stringify()) }; print(v)

cases.name: new-membership
cases.source: saved := []; i := 0; while(i<2) { f := x => newer+x; saved.push(f); if(i==0) { newer := 9 }; i+=1 }; newer := 7; print([1].map(saved[0]).stringify()); print([1].map(saved[1]).stringify())

cases.name: nested-escape
cases.source: f := x => (y => x+y); a := [1,2].map(f); first := a[0]; second := a[1]; print(first(7)); print(second(7)); print(first==second)

cases.name: local-capture-declaration
cases.source: v := 7; f := x => { v := 8; return v }; print([1].map(f).stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/local-capture-declaration.f:1:21: lambda body error: binding already declared in this scope: v

cases.name: local-param-declaration
cases.source: f := x => { x := 8; return x }; print([1].map(f).stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/local-param-declaration.f:1:13: lambda body error: binding already declared in this scope: x

cases.name: captured-mutation
cases.source: v := 0; f := x => ++v; print([1,2].map(f).stringify()); print(v)

cases.name: named-precedence
cases.source: fn(v()) { return 9 }; v := 3; f := x => v; print(type([1].map(f)[0]))

cases.name: location-invalid
cases.source: rows := [{"v":3}]; for(row : rows) { f := x => row.v+x; rows.clear(); print([1].map(f).stringify()); break }
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/location-invalid.f:1:48: lambda body error: reference target no longer exists: row.v+x

cases.name: location-reallocate
cases.source: rows := [{"v":3}]; for(row : rows) { f := x => row.v+x; rows.push({"v":9}); print([1].map(f).stringify()); break }

cases.name: unused-timer
cases.source: t := timer(); f := async x => x; print(await f(3))
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/unused-timer.f:1:46: async function capture contains a non-transferable timer

cases.name: param-timer
cases.source: x := timer(); f := async x => x; print(await f(3))
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/param-timer.f:1:46: async function capture contains a non-transferable timer

cases.name: root-readonly
cases.source: const rows := [{"v":3}]; for(row : rows) { f := x => row.v = x; print([1].map(f).stringify()); break }
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/root-readonly.f:1:54: lambda body error: member assignment requires a struct instance: row

cases.name: multi-param
cases.source: a := 99; b := 100; f := (a,b) => a+b; print([1,2].reduce(f,0)); print(a); print(b)

cases.name: non-numeric-fallback
cases.source: v := "abc"; f := x => v; print([1,2].map(f).stringify())

cases.name: error-origin
cases.source: v := 0; f := x => x/v; print([1,2].map(f).stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/error-origin.f:1:19: lambda body error: division by zero

cases.name: identity-retention
cases.source: fn(mk()) { f := x => x; return f }; a := mk(); b := mk(); print(a==b); print([2,1].sort_by(a).stringify())

cases.name: cmd-redeclaration
cases.source: f := x => { cmd := 7 }; print([1].map(f).stringify())
